{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check if missing sex is systematic across species
df_grouped = df.groupby('species').agg(
    count=('sex', 'count'),
    size=('sex', 'size'),
    missing=('sex', lambda x: len(x) - x.count())
)
print(df_grouped)"}
